title: Bobbins Table Menu
description: Build inter-linked quick launch dashboards of RollTables and Macros with a drag and drop text editor, styled buttons and one-click rolling to a popup or chat. Works with Bobbins Tables to create branching decision trees.

recommends.reason: When active, Bobbins Table Menu calls its rollTable() API directly for tables it manages, instead of interpreting its data independently.
